title: Captcha contract and recipe
why: Sites with a captcha had to open the CSP and carry the token by hand.
changelog: the CSP opens to the provider a captcha contract names; `brain recipe captcha`; `ctx.backend.login` and `signup` take `{ captcha }`; a one-use `login_grant` lasts 5 minutes; `operator_key_env` lets an operator skip the check; it fails closed
